title: STATE_INTERLEAVING: re-requesting and re-completing a refund after the order already reached its terminal 'completed' state may double the payout

inferred_invariant.statement: UIR-002 shows the order reaches a terminal state after refund completion ('This order has no actions requiring your attention.' / 'No further actions are available for this order.', observed at step 6). If the server allows POST /api/order/refund/request to reopen a completed order and a second POST /api/order/refund/complete to pay out again, totalReturned would exceed originalAmount (100), a direct financial-loss bug distinct from a simple immediate double-complete (plan 02) because it goes through a full request->complete->request->complete cycle.
